title: Rav Ika son of Rav Idi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bava Kamma 12a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.12a.9), but Hyman calls this a scribal error and says the reading should be “son of Rav Ami,” as explained in his entry.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara and its [alternate formulation](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.12a.11) both call him Rav Ika son of Rav Ami. [Heilprin’s Ami entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=457&lang=en) cites this daf, and his [separate Idi entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=460&lang=en) cites it as well. Hyman considers Idi a scribal error here.
